item.title: Michael Jackson’s ‘Moonwalk’ Is the King of Pop’s Only Autobiography: Here’s Where to Get the Book Online
item.description:
[Intro music plays]
Host: Welcome to this week's episode of Trending on Billboard. Today, we're taking a closer look at the life of the one and only Michael Jackson, also known as The King of Pop.
[Short music transition]
Host: As a megastar, Michael Jackson's life was always in the spotlight, but he managed to keep his personal life relatively private. However, in his autobiography, Moonwalk: A Memoir, he gives fans a glimpse into his world in his own words. This rare piece of music history is a must-read for new and old fans alike.
[Short music transition]
Host: In Moonwalk, Michael Jackson shares stories about his childhood, his time in the Jackson 5, and the inspirations behind some of his biggest hits like "Billie Jean," "Beat It," and "Thriller." He also writes candidly about his experiences with isolation, plastic surgery, and the rumors that surrounded him. The book is available on Amazon and Barnes & Noble, priced at $29 for the hardcover and $14.99 for the Kindle and eBook editions.
[Short music transition]
Host: And if you're a Michael Jackson fan, you'll be excited to know that his music is experiencing a resurgence in popularity, thanks in part to the new film about his early years. His landmark album Thriller has even returned to the number one spot on Billboard's Top R&B/Hip-Hop Albums chart, 40 years after its initial release.
[Outro music plays]
Host: That's all for today's episode. If you're interested in learning more about Michael Jackson's life, be sure to check out Moonwalk: A Memoir, available now on Amazon and Barnes & Noble. Thanks for tuning in, and we'll see you next time on Trending on Billboard.
[Outro music continues to play until the end]
